title: Garage setback from the primary street, R40 and above
text: C3.3.3 Garages are set back from the primary street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3c. Table 3.3c Setback of garages from the primary street: R40 and above, In accordance with Table 3.3a.

replaces.note: R40+ per Table 3.3a; R50+ 2 m unchanged

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Table 3.3c R40-and-above cell reads 'In accordance with Table 3.3a', so the primary street table is looked up directly. No reductions apply above R35. R100-SL not encoded (Table 2.10a 1 m would apply by the same reading).
